stimulus.text: The image is a hand-colored lithograph by George Catlin, made in the 1830s and 1840s from his travels on the Great Plains. It shows Native hunters on horseback chasing bison across grassland.
stimulus.source_note: Image from the shared image pool; George Catlin, Buffalo Hunt, public domain.

parts.prompt: Identify one feature of Plains life shown in the image.
Explain how one element of the image reflects change after European contact.
Explain one limitation of this image as evidence about Plains life before European contact.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
